chunks: And it has been narrated: “He comes out from his sins like the state in which his mother gave birth to him.”
ai.seo_question: How does hajj cleanse a person from sins according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the immense spiritual effect of the act under discussion, indicating that a person is cleansed from sins completely. It emphasizes divine mercy and the transformative purification associated with hajj.
